title: Collect Codex and Claude subscription allowance snapshots
goal: Persist safe provider/account quota observations independently of token events
acceptance: Read Codex account limits through official CLI app-server without model calls, login changes or credential extraction
Capture documented Claude Pro status-line allowance fields without persisting unrelated metadata/content
Validate immutable percentage/window/reset snapshots, missing/stale/reset behavior and replay; shared account deltas are not exact step cost
privacy: Private counter/allowance metadata only. No prompts, transcripts, credential extraction, account changes or reset-credit consumption.
validation: Owned source-to-ledger/report fixtures and meaningful failure cases
Final required CI and fresh-context independent report-only review
escalation: Material scope expansion or distinct outcome split requires owner agreement
Unknown or shared-source quota usage is not an exact per-task measurement

effort.basis: Provider availability and live client setup may constrain coverage; API limits/window lengths must be observed, not assumed.
